Owner: serve classes 1-9, all core subjects, foundational stage first-class
VM per build, folder per student, sandboxed iframe per play
Persistent VM per student: $0.5-20/student-month for no capability (cost arithmetic, not trial)
Lesson stage budgets in dp, solved at a 584 dp floor and 744 dp; geometry changes only at phase boundaries
Tap-to-talk is the default for every band on loudspeaker; open mic opt-in on headset or after EchoProbe; end-of-speech ramp 3 s Young / 2 s Older
Each of the four states is carried by pose + glyph + accessible name, colour last; turn ring darkened to #7A4800
Caption defaults follow reading level (R0 icon strip, R1 word follow-along, R2 subtitle on); captions-always is one child tap away
B3-B4 fork: Mukta display, flat tiles, hideable face, explainer notes, honest placement framing, study-tool home
No in-lesson progress meter; progress is a monotone, absence-invariant map with a list view; no props, name boards or reaction chips
Guardian PIN is the default parent gate; phone lock optional; consent-grade actions and PIN recovery need OTP off the shared device or a 24 h delay
Percentage shares for the lesson stage overflow budget phones (~117% of 800 dp)
Pale-gold chalk-mark underline beside the turn ring breaks the one-marigold rule (dE 6.7 under deuteranopia)
Design-token contrast and CVD: turn ring 3.01 -> 4.23:1 vs its fill; status pairs below dE 15 need glyphs; 0 failures
One legal_mode ratchet (M0-M3) gates every learner-layer write in code; M1 academic record at launch; M0 stateless fallback buildable in one transaction
One safety gate runs first on every child/parent utterance and pre-empts KT, need, memory, detectors, vibe, solo rounds and MRT arms; its output is never learner state
Knowledge = BKT-R per (child, skill) with review fixes: one transition per item-episode, per-session evidence budget, pL0=(P-g)/(1-g-s), retention=pL*R, idk outcome, mastered vs durable
One grade-equivalent scale (GE 0 = start of Class 1) and one success-first mixture-prior CAT for onboarding, need gap and KT priors; placement provisional until ~16 items per strand
One session-only engagement machine at launch (VT 5 states) fed by DA rule detectors via a verify-before-act arbiter; MI 11-moment filter deferred to v2 behind MM2
Realtime teacher gets a <=600-token key=value CHILD brief plus rung-gated LESSON NOW and a fixed tail VIBE -> PEDAGOGY NOW -> SAFETY -> TURN SHAPE (last), each budgeted
Student simulator: code decides, skin words, verifier checks; every learning-inference metric reported under two truth families and three gain tables; never efficacy
DPDP s.9(3) bars tracking/behavioural monitoring of children; D2C 'educational institution' status unsettled, so every persisted behavioural layer waits for counsel
Onboarding CAT simulation (computed, 1,500-3,000 sim children per row): SD<0.35 unreachable in 12 items; success-first cuts 3+-wrong runs 44%->8%; mixture prior 28%->7% placed >1 GE too high
First-session CAT stop at SD<0.35 (kt-algorithms D4): unreachable within 12 items, mean posterior SD 0.52-0.63 in simulation
'Recompute affect on replay, never store it' as a DPDP 9(3) shield: processing is the act, and the non-deterministic labeller makes replay need stored labels (rejected by review)
No parent-facing mastery words until K7: delayed accuracy of 'mastered' >= 0.9 at 1 and 4 weeks, ECE <= 0.05, n >= 200 children; until then 'answers observed'
First prod lesson on Azure: start 2.5 s, text turns 2.4-4.0 s, realtime token OK
